endpoint: Arithmetic mean(abs(ierr)) in each declared participant/condition, native released degrees of visual angle. Current released ierr is nonnegative; no new trial filters or imputation. trials is exact number of rows in that cell.

paired: Compute the declared linear combination for each of15people; n15, df14, mean difference, sample SD, SE=SD/sqrt15, t=mean/SE, dz=mean/SD, two-sided conventional Student t survival probability, unadjusted mean±t(.975,14)×SE. Equal exact differences imply zero variance: t/dz/p/CI null with undefined_zero_difference_variance. No replacement zeros/infinities.
ordering: Arbitrary order for cells, groups, contrast objects and JSON keys; identities complete and unique. CI endpoint order is lower,upper. Wrong finite numeric values are scored, not rejected for disagreement.
numeric_interface: JSON finite real scalars only; no Boolean, strings, NaN or infinity. Counts integer0..1000000; correct counts assessed numerically. All135cells,9groups,5spatial,6provenance comparisons required.
continuous_metrics: Participant×condition mean MAE in degrees (primary); count, group aggregation and each paired field MAE separately; explicit null/status mismatch counts. Lower numeric error is better; no threshold, significance reward or blended scientific success.

public_agreement_tolerance.meaning: Diagnostic arithmetic agreement only, not admission, scientific success or suppression of continuous errors.

finite_extremes: Unrepresentable derived arithmetic returns explicit unsupported_derived_numerics, never clipping/nonfinite JSON; own consistency failures do not erase computable reference comparisons.
